text: Caught up with Valentina after work. Her mum has her hip replacement on May 14 and Valentina is staying with her the week after. She sounded pretty anxious about it. Remind me to text her that morning.
Long call with Javier. He and Rosa finally signed for the flat in Leeds, keys on June 3rd. They're doing the move themselves the weekend after. He's still at the bank but wants to go remote.

spans.text: signed for the flat in Leeds

text: Pick up prescription, return the blue lamp to Dunelm, drop the parcel at the post office before 5.

spans.text: return the blue lamp to Dunelm
drop the parcel at the post office

text: Ivan says the knee op went fine. Discharged the next day, on crutches for six weeks. His wife Lila is doing all the driving now and is knackered. Should pop round with food at some point.

Saw Aiko at the school gate. She's viewing two flats in Bristol on 9/12, one near the harbour. Her boyfriend Rory is moving down a month later once his contract ends. She hates long commutes so the harbour one is the favourite.
Rory's scan got moved to July 8. Don't forget to ask him how it went the day after.

Lunch with Malik and Uma. Uma's dad is in hospital again with his heart, they've been back and forth all week. Malik is covering her shifts. They had to cancel the Lisbon trip, which was meant to be August 2nd. Need to check in with Uma at the weekend.
Note to self: book the van for the 21st, order boxes, and change address with the bank the day before.
Idris rang. His sister Blessing is having her gallbladder out on October 30th. She's terrified of the anaesthetic apparently. I'll send her something nice afterwards.
Archie (Arch) has moved into the new place in Glasgow. Says the flat is tiny but the light is amazing. His flatmate Sean plays the drums which is less amazing. Housewarming is Nov 7.

spans.text: moved into the new place in Glasgow

text: Mabel's cat Biscuit had a tooth out yesterday, she was a wreck in the waiting room. All fine now. Mabel is retiring in December too, big leaving do planned.
Quick chat with Lindiwe in the corridor. Her son starts at Edinburgh uni in September and she's already dreading the empty house.
Dentist Thursday 10am. Then council tip with the old mattress. Then actually relax.

spans.text: council tip with the old mattress

text: Eva told me she and Michael have pulled out of the house in Cardiff, the survey found subsidence. They're back to renting for now. She's gutted, she'd already picked out paint colours. Remind me to send her that listing on Cathedral Road.

spans.text: pulled out of the house in Cardiff
send her that listing on Cathedral Road

text: Lwazi's surgery went well, the surgeon said it was textbook. He's home on 4/22 and his partner Alessia has taken the week off. Need to call him a few days after he's home.

spans.text: a few days after he's home

text: Abebe moving to Toronto in March for the new job. Wife and kids follow in the summer once school finishes. He's excited but his youngest isn't happy about it at all.

Ming mentioned she's been on the waiting list for the cataract op for nearly a year. Finally got a date: Feb 19. She's worried about not being able to read for a while. She loves crime novels, maybe audiobooks would be a good gift.

spans.text: worried about not being able to read
audiobooks would be a good gift

text: Barbara's husband had a fall last week and broke his wrist. Barbara is managing but sounded tired. Should drop round on Saturday with soup.
Called the landlord about the boiler again. Engineer coming Monday morning, have to be in from 8.

Reggie and Ava had their second viewing in Manchester today. They loved the Didsbury one, putting an offer in tomorrow. Ava's mum is helping with the deposit. Don't forget to ask Reggie on Friday whether it was accepted.
Mrs Hughes from next door is in for her bypass on December 2nd. Her daughter is coming over from Dublin the day before to look after the dog. Reminder: water her plants while she's in.
Alejandro's back from hospital after the appendix scare. Turned out to be nothing serious, all clear. He's back at the restaurant already, which seems too soon.

Jack and Oisín are splitting up the flat when the lease ends on 1/31. Jack is going back to his parents in Cork, Oisín is looking at places in Dublin 8. Oisín is stressed about the prices, he's a junior architect and money is tight. I should send him that group chat with room listings.

spans.text: send him that group chat with room listings

text: Grocery run tonight. Need oat milk, bin bags, batteries for the smoke alarm.

Talked to Arturo for ages. His mum had a stroke on the 3rd and is in the rehab ward. He's been driving up to Preston every weekend and it's wearing him down. His brother Luca is no help apparently. Must call him Sunday evening to see how he's holding up.
Javier said the move went smoothly in the end, the van turned up late but they were in by teatime. Rosa's already painted the bedroom green. Ask them when they want people round.

spans.text: Ask them when they want people round

text: Uma got the date for her endoscopy, June 17th. Malik is taking her and then they're going for pancakes afterwards, her request.
Sean's off to Berlin for six months from April. Sublet sorted, job at a games studio. He's nervous about the language. Remind me to send him the Duolingo invite before he goes.
Mabel's leaving do is Friday Dec 12 at the Red Lion. Gift idea: she keeps saying she wants a proper bird feeder for the new garden.

spans.text: wants a proper bird feeder for the new garden

text: Spoke to Dr Kim about my results, nothing to worry about. Follow-up blood test in three months.
Ava texted. Offer accepted on the Didsbury flat! Completion probably mid August. Reggie is already measuring for a sofa. Need to get them a card.

spans.text: Offer accepted on the Didsbury flat

text: Idris's dad has his cataract surgery on 11/4 and Idris is driving him. They're getting lunch nearby afterwards so his dad doesn't sit in a waiting room all day.
Lila says Ivan is driving her mad on the crutches, refuses to rest. She's taking him to physio twice a week. Their daughter Barbara is home from uni the week after to help out.
Viewing at 6 on Elm Road. Bring passport and payslips. Check the water pressure this time.

Valentina's mum is out of hospital, went home two days after the op. Valentina's staying with her till the end of May. She mentioned she's behind on her thesis and panicking a bit. Should check in with her next week.

Saw Lindiwe and her husband at the farmers market. They're thinking of selling up and moving to the coast once their son's settled at uni. Lindiwe wants a garden for veg. Mentioned they're viewing a cottage in Whitby on Oct 25.
Adebayo called, his wedding in Lagos has been called off. Didn't say much. Him and his fiancée split last month. Should take him out for a pint soon, he needs it.

spans.text: take him out for a pint

text: Blessing's op went well, home the same evening. Idris says she's sore but cheerful. Remind me to message her on Wednesday.
Reminder to self: renew passport before the 30th, the Spain trip is May 3rd.
Michael is having his wisdom teeth out on the 15th. Eva is planning to look after him for the weekend afterwards and has bought a ridiculous amount of jelly.
Rosa's grandmother passed away on Tuesday. The funeral is in Seville on March 8 and Rosa and Javier are flying out the day before. Need to send flowers to Rosa's.
Aiko got the harbour flat! Moving in on September 28th. Rory's still in Leeds until late October. She wants help with the IKEA furniture that first weekend. I said yes.

Long catch-up with Alessia over coffee. Lwazi's recovering well, walking to the corner shop now. She's going back to work on Monday at the hospital pharmacy and feels guilty about it. Their dog Pepper has been glued to him. I need to ask her how the first day back went.

spans.text: ask her how the first day back went

text: Can't believe it's already the last week in the flat. Skip collection on Tuesday, deep clean Wednesday, keys back Thursday.
Malik's grandfather is ninety on July 19th. Huge family party in Birmingham. He says his grandad is obsessed with cricket so I'm thinking a framed scorecard or something.
Ming's cataract op went fine. She says everything is way too bright now. She's back at the library next week.
Archie's housewarming is off, his landlord is doing the bathroom that weekend. Moving it to the new year probably.

Michael rang about Eva. She's got a minor op on her shoulder on 8/14 and is really nervous because she's never been under general before. He's taking the week off. Her sister Valentina is coming down to stay too. Remind me to text Eva good luck the day before.
Jack's moved back to Cork and starts at the hospital in Cork University on Monday as a porter. Says it's a stopgap. Should message him to see how the first week went.
Luca had a hernia op last Friday. Arturo says he's moaning a lot but fine. Arturo also says their mum is improving, she can feed herself again.
Car MOT June 6. Haircut June 9. Then the flat viewing in Hackney that evening.
Abebe's farewell drinks are on Feb 27, the night before he flies. His team is doing a whip round. I should chip in.
Oisín found a room in Stoneybatter, moving on the 2nd. His new flatmate is a nurse who works nights so it'll be quiet. Feeling a lot better about it.
Barbara rang. Her husband's wrist needs a second operation on April 11, the first one didn't set right. She's fed up. I'll offer to drive them that morning.
Rory said the scan was clear. Big relief. He's celebrating with Aiko in Bristol that weekend.

Coffee with Alejandro. His partner Uma's sister is expecting twins in January. He also says the restaurant is moving to a bigger site across town, opening date April 1st. Ask him how the opening goes.

spans.text: moving to a bigger site across town
Ask him how the opening goes

text: Need to sort the broadband before the move. Call Virgin on Monday, cancel the gym, update address on the DVLA site.

spans.text: update address on the DVLA site

text: Adebayo's doing better. He's taken a new job in Leeds and moves up on 5/20. Says a fresh start is what he needs. Help him pack the week before.
Reggie's knee is playing up again, physio appointment on the 12th. He thinks he'll need an op eventually. Ava says he's in denial.
Uncle Abebe had his check-up and everything looks good. He's flying back to Addis on the 9th for his niece's wedding the week after.
